Why: The promise is the post, not the plan. The trailer of 09/28, posted on all 4 accounts, says: "1 true thing about this season, every night from tomorrow to Halloween. 33 nights. It starts tomorrow." It replaced the promise of 09/19 (post 7213386, 43 nights from 09/19), after 26 of those 43 nights went dark and the warm-up repeats were removed on 09/22. 33 is 09/29 through 10/31. The plan ran Facebook and YouTube on odd nights only while the trailer said every night on them too, so on 09/28 Amanda added the 16 even nights: all 4 accounts, every night. PerNight is 1 because the announcement says 1. It is a floor and a ceiling: 0 breaks the promise, 3 in a day is the month spent in a week.
WhyCountdown: 1 true fact a night from the start date to Halloween. The trailers state the number of nights left, so the number is only true on the day the post is scheduled. Inclusive means the start date is night 1. The 09/28 trailer counted from the next day: 33 nights from 09/29. Moving a trailer changes its number, which is what C04 is for.
